name: Indiana
agency: Indiana Department of Natural Resources, Law Enforcement Division

rule.textEn: To run a motorboat over 10 hp you need a valid driver license; without one, you must be at least 15, have passed a boater education course and hold a BMV ID card.
rule.textEs: Para manejar una lancha de más de 10 hp hace falta una licencia de conducir vigente; sin ella, hay que tener al menos 15 años, haber aprobado un curso de educación náutica y tener una tarjeta de identificación del BMV.

minAge.note: Without a driver license: 15+ with the course and a BMV ID card.

sources.quote: The operator of a motorboat, of more than 10 horsepower must have a valid driver’s license or be at least 15 years old and have passed a Boater Education Course and possess an identification card issued from the Bureau of Motor Vehicles. IC 14-15-11.
